023f4c704a.q: What is Christina Gomes' background in psychology and why did she transition from clinical practice?

She left the psychotherapy world because she felt incomplete without incorporating spirituality and spiritual concepts into her work. 7147f0489f.q: What happened to Christina Gomes this morning that became a teaching moment about standing up for what is right?
7147f0489f.a: Christina Gomes heard a neighbor hitting a dog outside her home in Guatemala, with the sounds of whacking and the dog yelping. When she spoke up, the neighbor told her to go back in the house, but instead of backing down due to fear or fawning, she channeled the archetype of Isis and stood up fiercely for the innocent. She describes this as embodying a living goddess and fierce empowerment, demonstrating how her inner work allowed her to activate her voice and not get sidetracked from her mission by trauma or fear.
